name: helux
description: A minimal macOS Electron app for switching between AI chat services.
author: Adrish

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --universal --config.directories.output=release
scripts.make:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --config.directories.output=release
scripts.make:mac:signed: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --config.directories.output=release

extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Helux may use Bluetooth security keys during sign-in.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Helux may use Bluetooth security keys during sign-in.
